verdict.rationale: Clerk documents official SDKs: it has docs on pinning a Clerk SDK version, an official clerk/javascript GitHub repo, Next.js integration, and an MCP server and CLI that give AI agents up-to-date Clerk SDK snippets. Community comments confirm hands-on use of the libraries, praising the Next.js integration but complaining about obfuscated code and dependency conflicts; these are quality caveats, not a contradiction. missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported SDK languages/frameworks, SDK reference documentation in the pack, independent corroboration of SDK quality beyond mixed community anecdotes.
